title: 花旗资管Jeannie：利率多高才会压垮企业盈利？
speaker: Jeannie

segments.en: So I was going to ask that at what point does higher rates, at what point doesn't really impact corporate fundamentals at earnings growth?
segments.zh: 我想问的是，利率高到什么程度才会真正影响企业基本面和盈利增长？

segments.en: Yeah, it's a great question, and unfortunately there's no just like one number, right, psychologically the marketplace, and many of our clients, we're very focused on 5% tenure, or 5.5% already here.
segments.zh: 这是个好问题，可惜并没有一个单一数字。心理上，市场和很多客户都非常关注5%的长期利率，现在已经到5.5%了。

segments.en: I think you have re-throughs historically into impact on things like residential mortgages and the housing industry, we're kind of in a different regime today.
segments.zh: 历史上利率会传导到住宅按揭和地产行业，但今天我们处在不同的环境里。

segments.en: A lot of the growth has been driven by industrial and AI growth and cat-backs, and they're actually what we're seeing is the market is actually able to absorb a lot of it, not just higher rates, but also the large amount of debt that's been issued by hyper-scalers.
segments.zh: 很多增长来自工业和AI领域的扩张，市场其实能够消化这些，不仅是更高利率，还有大型科技企业发行的大量债务。

segments.en: And so when you put all of these things together, you're getting a lot of points of data in the marketplace that the market is actually willing to absorb it because the growth prospects are so strong.
segments.zh: 把这些放在一起看，市场愿意消化这些数据，因为增长前景足够强劲。

segments.en: So we're not currently concerned, but we are watching the pace, and just whether or not there's increased volatility that maybe just is more surprising to the market.
segments.zh: 所以我们目前并不担忧，但会关注节奏，以及是否出现让市场更意外的波动加剧。

segments.en: And so if it kind of continues, and if we can explain it through the confluence of grinding higher inflation, but also solid growth, that is still an okay picture for us.
segments.zh: 如果这种状态延续，并且可以用通胀缓慢上行加上稳健增长来解释，那对我们来说仍然是可以接受的图景。

segments.en: But if you get, let's say, and this is not our base case, a really aggressive monetary policy response that's way more than what the marketplace expects right now, that could drive a little bit of volatility and derail some of what we're seeing in price action right now.
segments.zh: 但如果出现远超市场预期的激进货币政策反应——这不是我们的基准情形——可能会带来一些波动，并打乱当前的价格走势。

segments.en: Now, when you look at medium-term, we still see a really good runway for earnings, but that could drive some volatility. And we actually haven't seen a huge amount of it related to typical September volatility.
segments.zh: 中期来看，我们仍看到盈利有不错的空间，但这可能带来一些波动。实际上，我们并没有看到太多典型的九月波动。

segments.en: And so there are things that we've been expecting in the marketplace that we've been positioning for, that the market continues to absorb a lot of this noise pretty well.
segments.zh: 所以有些我们一直预期并提前布局的事情，市场仍在很好地消化这些噪音。
